decisions.reason: As a coolant pressure booster system that directly extends the firm's established coolant-management know-how, it fits existing engineering and service capabilities and is therefore likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge builds squarely on the firm's process-media and filtration knowledge, so its strong relatedness to existing R&D and customer applications makes continuation more likely than exit.
Coolant nozzles are a highly related add-on to the firm's coolant systems and, as a multi-model product line, they are likely to be retained as a modular complement to the broader offer.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's established conveying portfolio, and although slightly less core than coolant products, the firm's absorptive capacity and broad automation offer support keeping it on the market.

The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds on existing chip-handling and conveying competences, making it a natural portfolio extension that the firm can refine through its own engineering and customer feedback.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is closely related to the firm's conveyor and automation business, so in a growing industry a large German machinery producer would usually keep and iterate such a product rather than drop it quickly.
